A.  PRESENTATION TO OUTGOING MAYOR VELVETH SCHMITZ

MAYOR PRO TEM STEGURA thanked and recognized MAYOR SCHMITZ by briefly

MAYOR PRO TEM STEGURA presented MAYOR SCHMITZ with gifts including a
commemorative photo collage from her year as Mayor, and a gavel plaque including her

 10.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  TRAFFIC AND SAFETY COMMITTEE ACTION ITEM FROM MEETING OF
  NOVEMBER 20, 2024: IMPLEMENT “LEADING PEDESTRIAN INTERVAL” (LPI) AT
  THE INTERSECTION OF PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH (PVDN) AND PALOS
  VERDES DRIVE EAST (PVDE)

  Recommendation: That the City Council approve the re-programing of the traffic
  signals at PVDN and PVDE to implement the use of “Leading Pedestrian Interval”
  (LPI) for the pedestrian signals for all four crosswalks.

Public Works Director Wahba provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

Director Wahba explained how the leading pedestrian intervals work with the addition of four
seconds to the designated crossing times to give pedestrians a head start to be more visible
by motorists, in response to COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
Public testimony was received from resident Lynn Yen.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHACHTER moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  HUFF, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  APPROVE THE RE-PROGRAMING OF THE TRAFFIC SIGNALS AT PVDN
  AND PVDE TO IMPLEMENT THE USE OF “LEADING PEDESTRIAN
  INTERVAL” (LPI) FOR THE PEDESTRIAN SIGNALS FOR ALL FOUR
  CROSSWALKS.

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

B.  CIVIC PLUS MULTI-DEPARTMENTAL  SOFTWARE AGREEMENT FOR
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT, PUBLIC  WORKS, AND ADMINISTRATION
  DEPARTMENTS

  Recommendation: That the City Council approve the Service Agreement with
  CivicPlus for Multi-Department Software for the Community Development, Public
  Works, and Administration Departments.

Assistant City Manager Davis provided a staff report (as per the agenda material), followed
by Community Development Director Naughton.

COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ noted that in the event we needed to terminate the contract,
prior to any termination we should download any applicable data, as Civic Plus has the right
and ability to destroy it 30 days later.

Assistant City Manager Davis explained that other cities have reported that the number of
complaints has increased slightly after using this software but phone calls received generally
decrease, in response to COUNCIL MEMBER SCHACHTER.

Assistant City Manager Davis explained that business licenses would be handled through a
different portal, in response to MAYOR PRO TEM ZERUNYAN. She further explained the
backend process, in which the system notifies multiple staff members depending on the
nature of the complaint, and additionally tracks all communication throughout the entire
process of complaint’s resolution, in response to COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN.

Assistant City Manager Davis explained that staff will do a public education campaign once
implemented, in response to MAYOR STEGURA. She further explained that residents can
always contact City staff via phone.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  4
DECEMBER 10, 2024
   COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, TO
  APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  DEPARTMENT SOFTWARE FOR THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT,
  PUBLIC WORKS, AND ADMINISTRATION DEPARTMENTS.
